title: Retiring from Chase Manhattan, denied promotion because of race
summary: He retired December 1975 after being denied promotion, which he attributes to race.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Well now, one other thing that we can just get in -- veteran just say, when you quit the New York and Scene went to Texas --
Well, I retired from the bank in December, on December the 31st, 1975, but those people down at Chase Manhattan, first they didn't allow me any chance for
a promotion, although I had had a good record, got many commendations from them.
Did it have something to do with your age?
No, I think it was more due to the race.
